text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"If it isn't Fine-san and the Captain. Are 
you two heading out together?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good day to you♪ I'm just on my way to 
grab some ramen.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
I am accompanying you as your guard. My 
subordinates are also lying in wait along 
the way, so I doubt anything untoward 
could happen, but...

text_block_list.name: Transmission from SP
text_block_list.text:
“—This is Point Zero. Her Highness is 
currently in conversation. Squad A, remain 
on standby. Squad B, maintain perimeter 
surveillance—”

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm. As expected of a dedicated 
guardian. It seems I, too, have things to 
learn from him as a knight.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. After all, Durandal always says she 
wants to protect her lord as a knight."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, how about we go to a ramen 
shop together? I think it'll be a great 
learning experience♪

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
! I would love to accept, but... My Liege, 
what say you?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much! Well then!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
—The temperature is just right. Classic 
soy sauce sounds good, super spicy would 
hit the spot too. Even a light salt broth 
isn't bad—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(...Hmm. Captain-san has been periodically 
muttering under their breath for a while 
now... Could there be some hidden 
intention behind that too...?)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, curious? Well, you see... Partly 
it's so we don't look overly intimidating 
and make the people around us uneasy, and—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—It's because if everyone acts naturally, 
it makes it easier to spot suspicious 
people.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I see...! Thinking that far ahead—so that 
is the mindset... of a true Guardian.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now then, should I go with "light" or 
"rich"?♪ Which one are you two having?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...O, my Liege. Doesn't this picture of 
the 'light broth' look truly delicious?
choice_data_list: Well then, maybe I'll go with that one.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(...Fufu. I tried putting on my "guardian 
thinking cap" too—Fine-san.)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(If it's a thick, rich broth, you can't 
visually confirm if anything is lurking 
beneath. But... with a clear, light broth, 
it's entirely possible!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(This subtle, deep foresight... My Lord is 
sure to notice it! And then—praise me!)
choice_data_list: (I wonder if she prefers lighter foods...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, to see the true value in this light 
broth... Sir Durandal, you really know 
your stuff!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
“—I have learned something truly 
invaluable today. I offer my heartfelt 
gratitude, Your Highness Fine.”

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Masked Figure
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Fancy finding such a lively 
craftsman candidate in a place like this!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: !? Villain! Unhand my liege!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Masked Figure
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh, I'll be taking this. Starting 
today, you'll be working at my standing 
soba shop forever...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No way...! At least make it a standing 
ramen shop for them!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
“—I shall say it once more. Take your 
hands off of her.”

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Masked Figure
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, what are you saying...?! What can 
you possibly do unarmed!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. I shall show you too—my new 
technique, forged from my growth as a 
guardian today!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Holy Noodle Technique— 'Noodle Drain 
Grand Cross'!"

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Masked Figure
text_block_list.text: Gwaaah!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono! Are you injured?!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Masked Figure
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. That was a magnificent noodle 
shake, Lord Durandal."

The mysterious figure removed their 
suspicious mask. Revealed underneath 
was—the Head of Security!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: C-Captain!? Why are you...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, sorry about that. I just thought, to 
wrap up today, why not a trial that tests 
your courage as a knight?

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Putting one's life on the line to protect 
their master without the slightest flinch. 
She was truly the epitome of a knight.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No, I— I merely did what any knight would 
do.
choice_data_list: I want to bestow a commemorative title.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Ah, ngh, ah...! Th-Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...A-Ahem. I will always be the knight 
who protects you, after all."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Putting what I learned today to good 
use—I will continue to serve you with all 
my heart!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Then how about "The Knight of Ultimate 
Ramen," since you've mastered the essence 
of ramen?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? S-So cool...! As expected of my 
Lord...!

"And an investiture ceremony was held on 
the spot... adding the title of 'Knight of 
Ra' to Durandal's honors."
